test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

You will never regret this wonderful experience with your life.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the context of the sentence, the preposition **"with" **is incorrect because it suggests that you are having an experience in conjunction with your life, rather than as part of your life.
 
• The **correct preposition** to use here would be** "in"**, as in **"experience in your life".**

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** is: *"You will never regret this wonderful experience in your life."*
